fields.label: Grade
fields.description: The student's OWN current grade (1-12, SA CAPS calendar). The canonical field the catalog grade filter and Holiday Programme grade logic read — see lms/docs/student-grade-brief.md.

fields.label: Grade Confirmed On
fields.description: When the student last set or confirmed their grade. A value from a previous calendar year means the January rollover prompt is due (SA academic year = calendar year); rollover is prompt-to-confirm, never automatic.

fields.label: School
fields.description: The school the student attends, verbatim as entered/picked at onboarding or in profile settings (school-capture brief). Read by the per-curriculum distinct-schools suggestion query (rlms.api.student.known_schools) that feeds other students' suggest-as-you-type pools — never normalised in storage; dedupe happens query-side.

fields.label: Curriculum
fields.description: The curriculum derived from the student's school pick — the matched suggestion pool's curriculum, or the confirmed CAPS fallback for a free-typed, unlisted school (curriculum refinement). Display-stable strings: CAPS, IEB, Cambridge, US Common Core. Read by the distinct-schools suggestion query to bucket accumulated school names per curriculum.

fields.label: Maths Track
fields.description: Product log #29: a student takes Mathematics OR Mathematical Literacy, never both. Chosen at subscribe time; enforced server-side at enrolment and checkout (rlms.maths_track). Empty = not chosen yet.
